subject: Aligning procurement intake: MAP draft + PO gating checklist
messages:
From: Clara Zhou <clara@novaside.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reilly <treilly@nvscloud.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding — intake & PO gating questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We are excited to move toward production, and procurement asked that I consolidate a few items before the intake call so we can move quickly through PO issuance. Quick ask: can you confirm your standard PO gating checklist and any onboarding forms we should complete ahead of the kickoff?

Specifically Novaside needs clarity on:
- required legal/contract milestone before PO (e.g., SOW signed, PO-only ok)
- tax and vendor w9/W8 forms (we can provide our vendor packet)
- expected timeline for vendor activation once PR/PO is issued
- any security evidence (SOC2, data retention) needed at intake to avoid holdbacks

I attached our onboarding form and a short vendor profile. Would appreciate a short call next week to align MAP items and a checklist so our procurement can prepare the PR request.

Attachments: Novaside_Onboarding_Form.pdf

Thanks —
Clara
Vendor Success Manager
Novaside Technologies
clara@novaside.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Clara Zhou <clara@novaside.com>, Tom Reilly <treilly@nvscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — intake & PO gating questions

Hi Clara — thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. Helpful.

Two quick things from our side before we schedule:
1) I attached a one-page PO gating checklist we use internally (Redwood_PO_Gating_Checklist.xlsx) and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-Redwood-Novaside.docx). The checklist lists required docs for finance (W9/W8, tax ids), legal acceptance points (purchase order terms vs executed SOW), and who signs which milestone.
2) Our standard approach: we can start onboarding prep (security review, onboarding form, and environment setup) in parallel with contract negotiations so long as procurement is comfortable issuing a PO against the final price/terms. If legal requires an executed SOW before PO, that typically adds ~7–10 business days.

Proposed 30-minute intake call to align MAP, confirm owners, and set a target PO date:
- Wednesday 9 Dec, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thursday 10 Dec, 14:00–14:30 PT

Can you confirm availability and whether your procurement prefers PR->PO or SOW-first?

CCing Laura (Procurement lead) and Vivek (Customer Success) who will own activation milestones and acceptance criteria.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Clara Zhou <clara@novaside.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — intake & PO gating questions

Clara — quick note from Procurement so the call is efficient:

Prep requested by Redwood Finance/Legal (please bring these to the intake or upload to the shared Drive link before the call):
- Completed Novaside_Onboarding_Form.pdf (we need vendor remit + tax ids)
- Completed W9 or W8 (if non-US)
- Draft invoice template showing billing cadence and remit address
- Any reseller/subcontractor declarations if applicable
- Security evidence links (SOC 2 Type II report or a Red Team attestation), even if redacted

PO gating options:
- Fast-path: PO issued on approved pricing + standard terms (if Legal confirms no SOW required). Activation begins upon receipt of PO and confirmation of payment method. Target activation: 5 business days from PO.
- SOW-required path: PO waits until SOW executed. Target activation: ~10–15 business days post-executed SOW.

Success criteria for activation (so we have alignment on MAP):
- Vendor profile complete in Ariba/ERP
- Test API key provisioned and smoke-tested by CS within 48 hours of activation
- Billing account tied to customer PR and invoice schedule confirmed

I suggest we lock the MAP milestones on the call and assign owners. If Wednesday 9 Dec at 10 PT works, I will send a calendar invite and a short agenda (owners, docs outstanding, target PO date, activation acceptance criteria).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reilly <treilly@nvscloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Zhou <clara@novaside.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — intake & PO gating questions

Thanks — Wednesday 9 Dec at 10 PT works for Novaside.

We will:
- Upload the completed Novaside_Onboarding_Form.pdf and our W9 to your Drive link before 09:00 PT on Wednesday.
- Bring a billing/invoice template to the call.
- Review the MAP draft you attached; Clara will lead.

One note: Novaside prefers PO->activation (fast-path) where possible — legal aside, we typically accept PO as sufficient to start work. If anything on your checklist is missing, flag it during the call and we will prioritize.

See you on the call — invite pending.

Tom Reilly
Head of Partnerships
Novaside Technologies
